PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: RoboSep™ Mouse CD117 (cKIT) Positive Selection Kit with Filter Tips
PRODUCT_NAME: RoboSep™ Mouse CD117 (cKIT) Positive Selection Kit with Filter Tips
DESCRIPTION: Easily isolate highly purified mouse CD117+ cells from single-cell suspensions of mouse bone marrow or other tissue samples with the EasySep™ Mouse CD117 (cKIT) Positive Selection Kit. Widely used in published research for more than 20 years, EasySep™ combines the specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the simplicity of a column-free magnetic system. Using immunomagnetic positive selection, desired CD117+ cells are first labeled using the EasySep™ PE Positive Selection Cocktail, which contains phycoerythrin (PE)-conjugated antibodies directed against CD117. These PE-labeled antibodies are then targeted by antibody complexes that recognize both PE and dextran, along with magnetic particles. Labeled cells are separated using an EasySep™ magnet and by simply pouring off the unwanted cells. Following magnetic cell isolation, the desired CD117+ cells are PE-labeled and ready for downstream applications. Visit www.stemcell.com/easysep for more information. - 2 X 10^9 Cells

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Human FATP3(Fatty Acid Transport Protein 3) ELISA Kit
DESCRIPTION: The test principle applied in this kit is Sandwich enzyme immunoassay. The microtiter plate provided in this kit has been pre-coated with an antibody specific to Human FATP3. Standards or samples are added to the appropriate microtiter plate wells then with a biotin-conjugated antibody specific to Human FATP3. Next, Avidin conjugated to Horseradish Peroxidase (HRP) is added to each microplate well and incubated. After TMB substrate solution is added, only those wells that contain Human FATP3, biotin-conjugated antibody and enzyme-conjugated Avidin will exhibit a change in color. The enzyme-substrate reaction is terminated by the addition of sulphuric acid solution and the color change is measured spectrophotometrically at a wavelength of 450nm ± 10nm. The concentration of Human FATP3 in the samples is then determined by comparing the OD of the samples to the standard curve.

PRODUCT_NAME: AccuPlate Hot Plate Stirrer, 5 x 7 in. Ceramic Top, 120V
DESCRIPTION:
Labnets AccuPlate™ digital hot plates and stirrers are versatile, powerful, and easy to use. Every unit is built for consistent performance and long term reliability. With three models to choose from, there is an AccuPlate™ hot plate and stirrer to meet your labs needs.

Each AccuPlate™ is equipped with a Pyroceram ceramic top plate that is extremely durable, easy to clean, and is highly resistant to chemical attack. In addition, the 5 x 7 in. ceramic plates can reach higher temperatures (rated to 550 DEG C†) than metal topped units and the white color makes it easy to view color changes in applications such as titrations. The AccuPlate™ Hotplate and Hotplate Stirrer models incorporate a powerful heating element positioned directly beneath the ceramic top plate. This provides optimal heat transfer to the plate and sample while minimizing heat transfer to the electronics and housing.

The Stirrer and Hotplate Stirrer utilize a powerful motor drive system paired with strong permanent magnets to ensure a consistent connection to the stir bar. The control software is designed to minimize stir bar decoupling by regulating the acceleration rate of the motor. The durable cast aluminum housing and angled faceplate protect the electronics in the event of an accidental spill. The Hotplate and Hotplate Stirrer models also feature a bright red Hot Top indicator to alert users that the ceramic top is too hot to touch - even if the heater is off, the light will remain on until the top has cooled to a safe temperature.

• Precise liquid temperatures and stirring speeds
• Digital display and safety indicators
• Angled front panel and large control knobs
• Unit dimensions (W x D x H): 19.7 x 28 x 10.8 cm

†Temperature range using the External Temperature Controller is 5 DEG to 200 DEG C (41 DEG to 392 DEG F)

PRODUCT_NAME: CytoCHECK SPAchip® OHrad ROS Single-Detection Kit
DESCRIPTION:
CytoCHECK SPAchip® OHrad ROS Single-Detection Kit allows real-time monitoring of intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) through the specific detection of hydroxyl radicals (•OH) via changes in green fluorescence intensity within living cells. This product enables to measure •OH radicals generated either as primary ROS or as secondary species downstream of other ROS, facilitating a more comprehensive study of live cell physiology, proliferation, differentiation, cell death, and ferroptosis.


CytoCHECK SPAchip® OHrad ROS Single-Detection Kit is pH-insensitive: experimental readouts obtained from this product are not affected by pH changes of the media, avoiding measurement artifacts due to pH variations. 


CytoCHECK SPAchip® OHrad ROS Kit is only active when in contact with intracellular esterases, obtaining a fluorescent signal with internalized SPAchips.

PRODUCT_NAME: Ultraseal LITE Semi-Automated Microplate Heat Sealer, 115 or 220 VAC
DESCRIPTION:
The Ultraseal™ LITE semi-automatic microplate heat sealer from Finneran Porvair processes deep well, shallow well, low profile deep well, filter, and assay plates that conform to the ANSI/SLAS standard format. The Ultraseal™ LITE heat sealer operates using 400W of heating elements that ensure high integrity sealing of almost any type of microplate. With so much available power, sealing times for most polypropylene plates are less than three seconds each. Sealed plates are automatically ejected, from the unit, when the sealing cycle has completed. The compact footprint means that the Ultraseal™ LITE will fit just about anywhere - lab bench or inside a fume hood, if required.

Keypoints:
• Ultraseal™ LITE heat sealer has been designed to seal most types of microplates
• Utilizes various heat seal films and foils to give either permanent or peelable seals for all common microplate material types (polypropylene, polystyrene, polyethylene)
• Sealing times and temperatures are fully adjustable via the control touchscreen
• Fully compatible with ANSI/SLAS standard plates and PCR, if full skirted
• Dual voltage capability, operating on either 110 or 220 VAC supplies without the need for a power transformer

Features and Benefits:
• Desktop semi-automatic heat applied microplate sealing system
• Seals SBS format microwell plates and tubes
• Seals plates of any height from 9 - 54mm
• Temperature range from ambient to 200°C
• Seal time from 10 - 20 seconds (based on a 2 second seal)
• Semi-automated slide operation
• Combined temperature and seal time display
• Light weight system, only 9.2 kgs (20 lbs)
• No compressed air required
• 2 mm, 2.75 mm, 3.5 mm risers included with unit

For Sealing PCR Plates - No Skirt or Half Skirt:
